competitions.result: Semi-final — lost 3–2 on aggregate to Queens Park Rangers.
Reached the final — the two final legs were played in September 1986, during the next campaign.

overview: Kenny Dalglish became Liverpool’s player-manager in the summer of 1985 and won the club’s first league and FA Cup double in his first season. Liverpool finished two points ahead of Everton in the First Division. Dalglish scored the only goal at Chelsea in the final league match to secure the championship.

A week later, Liverpool beat Everton 3–1 in the FA Cup final. Ian Rush scored twice and Craig Johnston once as Liverpool came from behind at Wembley. Rush finished with 33 goals across all competitive fixtures, including two in the Football League Super Cup. Steve McMahon joined from Aston Villa, while Alan Kennedy and Phil Neal departed.

Queens Park Rangers ended Liverpool’s League Cup run in the semi-finals. With English clubs excluded from Europe, Liverpool also played in the new Super Cup and reached its final by beating Norwich City. The final against Everton was postponed until September 1986, so its outcome belongs to the following campaign.

The Super Cup’s edition was 1985–86, but its September 1986 final is recorded in 1986–87, when it was played. It is not counted as a trophy won during this campaign.
